dopamine_shorts.title: Escaping the Infinite Scroll
steps: Place your hand on your heart and take three deep breaths.
Recall your intention for this session. What did you come to do?
Open your task list and pick one small task to complete now.
If the urge persists, set a 5-minute timer and allow yourself a mindful pause.

social_media.title: Stepping Away from the Feed
steps: Close the tab and place your phone face-down, out of reach.
Breathe in for four counts, hold for four, and breathe out for four.
Name one person or thing you truly care about, and why.
Choose a real action that honors them — a message, a task, a walk.

gaming.title: Returning from the Match
steps: Pause the game, stand up, and stretch your shoulders.
Take three slow breaths, feeling the ground beneath your feet.
Ask: what were you about to do before the session began?
Commit to one 20-minute deep work block before any play.

adult_content.title: Guarding the Mind's Door
steps: Close the tab immediately and step away from the screen.
Take five slow breaths and observe the urge without chasing it.
Remind yourself: the craving is impermanent — it will pass.
Engage your body with something grounding: water, a walk, push-ups.
If it returns, tell a trusted friend or write one honest line about it.

gambling.title: Walking Away from the Wager
steps: Stop, close the tab, and step outside for a few minutes.
Breathe deeply and notice what the urge is really asking for.
Remember: the house always wins — this is not a path to safety.
Set a hard block on this category for the rest of the day.
Reach out to someone you trust about what you are feeling.

streaming.title: Coming Back to the Present
steps: Pause the stream and notice the time that has quietly passed.
Take three breaths and gently scan how your body feels.
Return to the task you set for yourself before pressing play.
Choose a mindful alternative: a walk, music, or writing a few lines.

entertainment.title: Choosing Mindful Rest
steps: Pause and name what rest truly looks like for you today.
Breathe out slowly and release tension in your jaw and shoulders.
Swap one binge for one intentional break: a walk, a stretch, a chat.
Return to your intention and take one small productive step.

shopping.title: Letting Go of the Cart
steps: Empty the cart and close the tab with a gentle breath.
Ask: what need is this purchase trying to fill?
Write the item down with today's date and revisit it in three days.
Spend ten minutes on something that costs nothing: a walk, a book.

browsing.title: Reclaiming the Wandering Tab
steps: Close every tab except the one task you are doing now.
Take three breaths and notice the pull to wander.
Set a timer for 25 minutes and commit to a single task.
When it rings, stretch and decide consciously what comes next.

generic.title: A Mindful Return
steps: Pause wherever you are and take three slow, full breaths.
Notice the urge as a passing cloud — watch it, do not chase it.
Ask yourself: what was I intending to do today?
Take one small, kind step toward that intention right now.
